geometryMethod: Reviewed OSM corridor geometry, with schematic station links and short published-stop corridors. Remaining long gaps are traced along reviewed OSM and shared passenger corridor geometry; nearby corridor cuts may be joined for readability without merging station identities. Display routes do not establish operational train paths or create direct destinations.

quarantinedOriginEntries.name: 牛车河
quarantinedOriginEntries.reason: The third-party city catalogue assigns Hunan's Niuchehe passenger station to Zibo, Shandong. Do not create a Shandong origin from this contradictory entry.

quarantinedOriginEntries.name: 向阳
quarantinedOriginEntries.reason: 许昌目录的4052时刻实际属于鸡西—牡丹江，不能给河南同名车站套用黑龙江客运事实。两个同名站不得合并。

quarantinedOriginEntries.name: 石城
quarantinedOriginEntries.reason: 赣州目录的石城页面引用丹东—通化4317至4320停站表；不能套用到江西。石城东独立登记保留，未把两站合并。

correctedOriginEntries.name: 芦台
correctedOriginEntries.reason: 天津宁河区交通规划确认芦台站位于宁河。纠正源目录行政归属，保留原始入口、独立站点ID和坐标。

correctedOriginEntries.name: 高密北
correctedOriginEntries.reason: 国家发改委济青铁路站序与独立OSM车站对象证明这是山东高密的客运站；第三方将其误列河北张家口。保留独立ID并纠正目录归属。
